content: You are young, my son, and, as the years go by, time will change and even reverse many of your present opinions.
author: Plato
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Human beings are never a finished product; we exist in perpetual transit between our basic instincts and our highest potential. The tension we feel inside is not a flaw—it is the very engine of self-evolution.

Across his life and work, Plato saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Growing into a fuller version of yourself requires crossing uncertain territory with no safety net. You have to be willing to outgrow the comfort of familiar limitations to step into who you are capable of becoming.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
